sample_size.notes: Bull-market sample is a continuation/reversal mix; bear-market sample tends to be bullish reversal.

target_calculation.description: Target = highest peak (between bottoms) + (peak - bottom). Project upward from breakout above the highest peak.

ultimate_high_method.definition: Highest price after upward breakout before 20% reversal

failure_definition.description: Break-even failure: price fails to rise 5% above breakout (i.e., drops back below the highest peak).

post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_note: Median ~123 days. Bull market slower (165 days to ultimate high), bear market faster (80 days).

performance_statistics.best_market: bull (37% rise, 4% BE failure — strong bullish reversal)
